moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio pt-twinkle, written here): 12 four-point sparkles at seeded spots; each repeats every 1.5 s with a seeded phase and glows only in the first 35 % of its cycle: size 4 -> 4 + 10 x seed -> 4 as sin(pi u) (recipe: 600 ms, scale 0 -> 1 -> 0, ease-in-out), turning slowly at 0.5 rad / s; 2 in 3 yellow, 1 in 3 accent. Never all at once. Params: count (12) · duration mỗi lần loé (0.6 s) · seed.
